# Pinned Drut conformance vectors

These files are a verbatim copy of the conformance corpus from
[finalclass/drut-spec](https://github.com/finalclass/drut-spec) at the revision
pinned by [docs/wire.md](../../../docs/wire.md):

```text
0d4b4e1e7ef3d7fffe095bfa9b2d88b564e9da8a
```

Files: `schemas.json`, `valid.json`, `invalid.json`, `invalid-schemas.json`.
The corpus is authored by that project and is distributed under its MIT license
(see the upstream repository). It is vendored only to run the adapter in
`test/drut/adapter.ts` without a network dependency.
